title: AI Agent Platform Engineer
responsibilities: Build LLM agents that select tools, call retrieval systems, and record execution traces.
Develop FastAPI services for agent workflows, structured outputs, and evaluation dashboards.
Improve reliability of generated reports through evidence grounding and automated tests.
requirements: Experience with Python backend development and REST APIs.
Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, tool calling, RAG, and embeddings.
Familiarity with Docker, testing, observability, and production debugging.
nice_to_haves: Knowledge of retrieval evaluation metrics such as Recall@k, MRR, and nDCG.

AI Agent Platform Engineer

title: RAG Engineer
responsibilities: Design hybrid retrieval pipelines that combine lexical and semantic search.
Evaluate retrieval quality with labeled datasets and ranking metrics.
Build evidence-grounded answer generation workflows for enterprise documents.
requirements: Experience implementing retrieval, ranking, or recommendation systems.
Understanding of BM25, embeddings, vector similarity, and reranking.
Ability to design small evaluation sets and analyze retrieval failures.
nice_to_haves: Experience with FAISS, Chroma, Qdrant, or similar vector stores.
